_comment: Shared, NON-SECRET MCP server definitions — single source of truth for both Claude Code (~/.claude.json) and Claude Desktop. NO Docker: every server here is a plain stdio launcher (npx/go/uvx). Secret env values (karakeep token) are injected at apply time from OpenBao by the merge scripts. Three servers are NOT listed here because their shape differs per-app or per-OS and the merge scripts inject them: github + outline are remote HTTP (http for Code, npx mcp-remote bridge for Desktop) with a baked Bearer token; signal is a per-OS stdio launcher (uv path + repo dir differ macOS vs Linux) talking to the signal-cli daemon (tcp 127.0.0.1:7583). Edit here, then chezmoi apply.

aws._comment: AWS MCP Server (GA 2026). The SERVER is remote and managed by AWS; mcp-proxy-for-aws is the local stdio bridge that signs each request with SigV4, because the remote endpoint speaks IAM rather than OAuth. No token to store: it uses the standard boto credential chain, so it picks up whatever Vault Agent has rendered (secrets-aws.env) or ~/.aws. Version pinned deliberately — an unpinned uvx resolves to whatever is newest at launch, which is a moving dependency in a config that is supposed to be reproducible. First run downloads ~75 packages; later runs are cached. Endpoint region (us-east-1) is the service's, and is independent of AWS_REGION, which is the region the tools operate ON.
